content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Placement & Career Development): Postgraduate degree in Law, Social Sciences or MBA (HR) with a minimum of 55% marks. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in the field of training, mentorship, career development and placement services. Experience of working with NLUs/Law Schools.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Consultant (Placement & Career Development): As per market standards; no bar for a deserving candidate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NLU Delhi Consultant (Placement & Career Development) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NLU Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by National Law University Delhi (NLU Delhi) for hiring contractual professionals in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under Advt No NLUD/Admin./2026/2776?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Consultant (Placement & Career Development) under National Law University Delhi for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Placement & Career Development) post in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 30th October 2026 up to 2:00 PM via the portal.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in Law, Social Sciences, or MBA (HR) with a minimum of 55% marks along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required to apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applicants must have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in training, mentorship, career development, and placement services.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General category candidates is Rs. 2500/-, while SC, ST, and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for NLU Delhi Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on application documents followed by an interview conducted at the NLU campus.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or remuneration for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The salary is as per market standards with no bar for a deserving candidate possessing exceptional qualifications and relevant background.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online directly by visiting the official NLU Delhi careers website before the deadline.
